# Sadiq Zahir

> Author, speaker and peer support advocate based in Norfolk, Virginia. Founder of Sadiq Zahir Speaks and author of the memoir The Strength of the Surviving Twin (2026). Speaks in schools, hospitals, reentry programs and community settings on rebuilding after incarceration, grief and the recovery of purpose.

## Topics
Reentry and second chances; peer support; grief and loss (surviving twin); men's accountability and fatherhood; youth mentorship.

## Work
Mentor, Bridge The Gap Youth Program. Leads a men's accountability group in Hampton Roads.

## Credentials
Certified Life Skills Coach; CBT Certified Practitioner; Motivational Interviewing training.
